name: Expo
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Palo Alto, CA, USA
long_description:
Expo is agentic mobile infrastructure. Developers and AI agents use Expo to create, build, test, validate, ship, and update apps for Android, iOS, and the web from one codebase. 

The open-source Expo framework gets an app started, and Expo Services handles the rest in the cloud: Expo Build and Expo Submit for app stores, Expo Update for over-the-air updates, Expo Workflows for CI/CD, Expo Simulators for remote iOS Simulators and Android Emulators, and Expo Observe for production performance. Indie developers and some of the world’s largest companies use Expo to ship faster.
one_liner: The fastest way to build and run apps
